0022600041.text: The Sacramento Kings (1-10, 0-6 at home, 14th in the West) host the Portland Trail Blazers (7-3, 8th in the West, 0.5 games behind for third in the Northwest) in the Kings' 12th game of the season, with Sacramento on a four-game losing streak and 1-9 over its last ten. Portland won the only meeting so far in 2026-27, 128-120 in Sacramento on October 23, so the Kings trail 0-1 in the season series, and they lost 0-4 to Portland in 2025-26. Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery) and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), and Precious Achiuwa (lower leg bruise) is day-to-day and a game-time decision, while Portland is missing Ja Morant (hamstring), Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery), and Vit Krejci (ankle).
